title: CDS Token Document (v1)
description: Structural JSON Schema for a CDS machine-readable token source document (strict JSON, .tokens.json) over DTCG 2025.10. Validates strict structure, DTCG group/token shape, the CDS $extensions payload, and the segment naming profile. It does NOT establish full DTCG, semantic, accessibility, governance, reference-resolution, or Product-Profile correctness (those are V2, V3, V4). Non-normative structural contract; asserts no Candidate or Stable status.

nameSegment.description: A single technical name segment: lower-case start, lower-case alphanumerics and single hyphens; no reserved characters, no whitespace, no empty segments (DEC-S-081).

sourceSetId.description: Segment-based source-set identity (DEC-S-081). Case-sensitive; case-only collisions are prohibited but not detectable by pattern alone (V3 responsibility).

localRef.description: A local / relative reference only. No network scheme (http(s)/file) and no absolute UNC path (DEC-S-091).

rootExtensions.description: Document-root $extensions. Requires the CDS source-set identity payload; foreign extensions are preserved (not automatically normative for CDS).

tokenExtensions.description: Token- or group-level $extensions. The CDS token payload is optional; foreign extensions are preserved.

cdsSourceSetPayload.description: CDS source-set identity, carried at the document root under io.github.kaykaspers.cds. Unknown CDS payload fields fail closed (additionalProperties false).

cdsTokenPayload.description: Optional per-token/group CDS governance metadata. Unknown CDS payload fields fail closed.

node.description: A DTCG node: a token (has $value) or a group (has named child nodes). Only $value/$type/$description/$deprecated/$extensions and lower-case name segments are permitted; any other member (including unknown $-prefixed or upper-case keys such as preview features) fails closed.
